verses.text: I say then, God has not rejected His people, has He? May it never be! For I too am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.
verses.textZh: 我且說，神棄絕了他的百姓麼？斷乎沒有！因為我也是以色列人，亞伯拉罕的後裔，屬便雅憫支派的。

verses.text: God has not rejected His people whom He foreknew. Or do you not know what the Scripture says in [the passage about] Elijah, how he pleads with God against Israel?
verses.textZh: 神並沒有棄絕他預先所知道的百姓。你們豈不曉得經上論到以利亞是怎麼說的呢？他在神面前怎樣控告以色列人說：

verses.text: 'Lord, THEY HAVE KILLED YOUR PROPHETS, THEY HAVE TORN DOWN YOUR ALTARS, AND I ALONE AM LEFT, AND THEY ARE SEEKING MY LIFE.'
verses.textZh: 主阿，他們殺了你的先知，拆了你的祭壇，只剩下我一個人，他們還要尋索我的命。

verses.text: But what is the divine response to him? 'I HAVE KEPT for Myself SEVEN THOUSAND MEN WHO HAVE NOT BOWED THE KNEE TO BAAL.'
verses.textZh: 神的回話是怎麼說的呢？他說：我為自己留下七千人，是未曾向巴力屈膝的。

verses.text: In the same way then, there has also come to be at the present time a remnant according to [God's] gracious choice.
verses.textZh: 如今也是這樣，照著揀選的恩典，還有所留的餘數。

verses.text: But if it is by grace, it is no longer on the basis of works, otherwise grace is no longer grace.
verses.textZh: 既是出於恩典，就不在乎行為；不然，恩典就不是恩典了。

verses.text: What then? What Israel is seeking, it has not obtained, but those who were chosen obtained it, and the rest were hardened;
verses.textZh: 這是怎麼樣呢？以色列人所求的，他們沒有得著，惟有蒙揀選的人得著了；其餘的就成了頑梗不化的。

verses.text: just as it is written, 'GOD GAVE THEM A SPIRIT OF STUPOR, EYES TO SEE NOT AND EARS TO HEAR NOT, DOWN TO THIS VERY DAY.'
verses.textZh: 如經上所記：神給他們昏迷的心，眼睛不能看見，耳朵不能聽見，直到今日。

verses.text: And David says, 'LET THEIR TABLE BECOME A SNARE AND A TRAP, AND A STUMBLING BLOCK AND A RETRIBUTION TO THEM.
verses.textZh: 大衛也說：願他們的筵席變為網羅，變為機檻，變為絆腳石，作他們的報應。

verses.text: 'LET THEIR EYES BE DARKENED TO SEE NOT, AND BEND THEIR BACKS FOREVER.'
verses.textZh: 願他們的眼睛昏矇，不得看見；願你時常彎下他們的腰。

verses.text: I say then, they did not stumble so as to fall, did they? May it never be! But by their transgression salvation [has come] to the Gentiles, to make them jealous.
verses.textZh: 我且說，他們失腳是要他們跌倒麼？斷乎不是！反倒因他們的過失，救恩便臨到外邦人，要激動他們發憤。

verses.text: Now if their transgression is riches for the world and their failure is riches for the Gentiles, how much more will their fulfillment be!
verses.textZh: 若他們的過失，為天下的富足，他們的缺乏，為外邦人的富足；何況他們的豐滿呢？

verses.text: But I am speaking to you who are Gentiles. Inasmuch then as I am an apostle of Gentiles, I magnify my ministry,
verses.textZh: 我對你們外邦人說這話；因我是外邦人的使徒，所以敬重（原文作：榮耀）我的職分，

verses.text: if somehow I might move to jealousy my fellow countrymen and save some of them.
verses.textZh: 或者可以激動我骨肉之親發憤，好救他們一些人。

verses.text: For if their rejection is the reconciliation of the world, what will [their] acceptance be but life from the dead?
verses.textZh: 若他們被丟棄，天下就得與神和好；他們被收納，豈不是死而復生麼？

verses.text: If the first piece [of dough] is holy, the lump is also; and if the root is holy, the branches are too.
verses.textZh: 所獻的新麵若是聖潔，全團也就聖潔了；樹根若是聖潔，樹枝也就聖潔了。

verses.text: But if some of the branches were broken off, and you, being a wild olive, were grafted in among them and became partaker with them of the rich root of the olive tree,
verses.textZh: 若有幾根枝子被折下來，你這野橄欖得接在其中，一同得著橄欖根的肥汁，

verses.text: do not be arrogant toward the branches; but if you are arrogant, [remember that] it is not you who supports the root, but the root [supports] you.
verses.textZh: 你就不可向舊枝子誇口；若是誇口，當知道不是你托著根，乃是根托著你。

verses.text: You will say then, 'Branches were broken off so that I might be grafted in.'
verses.textZh: 你若說，那枝子被折下來是特為叫我接上。

verses.text: Quite right, they were broken off for their unbelief, but you stand by your faith. Do not be conceited, but fear;
verses.textZh: 不錯！他們因為不信，所以被折下來；你因為信，所以立得住；你不可自高，反要懼怕。

verses.text: for if God did not spare the natural branches, He will not spare you, either.
verses.textZh: 神既不愛惜原來的枝子，也必不愛惜你。

verses.text: Behold then the kindness and severity of God; to those who fell, severity, but to you, God’s kindness, if you continue in His kindness; otherwise you also will be cut off.
verses.textZh: 可見神的恩慈和嚴厲，向那跌倒的人是嚴厲的，向你是有恩慈的；只要你長久在他的恩慈裡，不然，你也要被砍下來。

verses.text: And they also, if they do not continue in their unbelief, will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.
verses.textZh: 而且他們若不是長久不信，仍要被接上，因為神能夠把他們從新接上。

verses.text: For if you were cut off from what is by nature a wild olive tree, and were grafted contrary to nature into a cultivated olive tree, how much more will these who are the natural [branches] be grafted into their own olive tree?
verses.textZh: 你是從那天生的野橄欖上砍下來的，尚且逆著性得接在好橄欖上，何況這本樹的枝子，要接在本樹上呢！

verses.text: For I do not want you, brethren, to be uninformed of this mystery-- so that you will not be wise in your own estimation-- that a partial hardening has happened to Israel until the fullness of the Gentiles has come in;
verses.textZh: 弟兄們，我不願意你們不知道這奧祕（恐怕你們自以為聰明），就是以色列人有幾分是硬心的，等到外邦人的數目添滿了，

verses.text: and so all Israel will be saved; just as it is written, 'THE DELIVERER WILL COME FROM ZION, HE WILL REMOVE UNGODLINESS FROM JACOB.'
verses.textZh: 於是以色列全家都要得救。如經上所記：必有一位救主從錫安出來，要消除雅各家的一切罪惡；

verses.text: 'THIS IS MY COVENANT WITH THEM, WHEN I TAKE AWAY THEIR SINS.'
verses.textZh: 又說：我除去他們罪的時候，這就是我與他們所立的約。

verses.text: From the standpoint of the gospel they are enemies for your sake, but from the standpoint of [God's] choice they are beloved for the sake of the fathers;
verses.textZh: 就著福音說，他們為你們的緣故是仇敵；就著揀選說，他們為列祖的緣故是蒙愛的。

verses.text: for the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.
verses.textZh: 因為神的恩賜和選召是沒有後悔的。

verses.text: For just as you once were disobedient to God, but now have been shown mercy because of their disobedience,
verses.textZh: 你們從前不順服神，如今因他們的不順服，你們倒蒙了憐恤。

verses.text: so these also now have been disobedient, that because of the mercy shown to you they also may now be shown mercy.
verses.textZh: 這樣，他們也是不順服，叫他們因著施給你們的憐恤，現在也就蒙憐恤。

verses.text: For God has shut up all in disobedience so that He may show mercy to all.
verses.textZh: 因為神將眾人都圈在不順服之中，特意要憐恤眾人。

verses.text: Oh, the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable are His judgments and unfathomable His ways!
verses.textZh: 深哉，神豐富的智慧和知識！他的判斷何其難測！他的蹤跡何其難尋！

verses.text: For WHO HAS KNOWN THE MIND OF THE LORD, OR WHO BECAME HIS COUNSELOR?
verses.textZh: 誰知道主的心？誰作過他的謀士呢？

verses.text: Or WHO HAS FIRST GIVEN TO HIM THAT IT MIGHT BE PAID BACK TO HIM AGAIN?
verses.textZh: 誰是先給了他，使他後來償還呢？

verses.text: For from Him and through Him and to Him are all things. To Him [be] the glory forever. Amen.
verses.textZh: 因為萬有都是本於他，倚靠他，歸於他。願榮耀歸給他，直到永遠。阿們！
